notes: All figures from TSMC's FY2025 Form 20-F (fiscal year ended 31 December 2025; accession 0001628280-26-025362, filed April 16, 2026), read on www.sec.gov. Amounts are NT$ (ISO TWD) millions converted to billions. FOUNDER: Morris Chang retired in 2018. His name does not appear anywhere in the FY2025 20-F (Item 6 directors and officers and Item 7 major shareholders were checked), so status is no-reported-stake. HOLDERS: the National Development Fund (6.38%) is the only 5%+ holder in the 20-F. The 2025 English annual report's top-ten shareholder list (which in the previous edition gave the Government of Singapore and Norges Bank custody accounts) could not be fetched: investor.tsmc.com returns HTTP 403 to scripted requests (Cloudflare), so those holders are not listed this year. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Treasury stock acquired' is nil for 2025 and Item 16E says 'Not applicable', so buybacks are 0. DIVIDENDS: cash-flow line 'Cash dividends' (NT$466,779.2 million paid in 2025); it differs from the NT$531,618.4 million declared in the equity statement because quarterly dividends are paid about six months after approval. STOCK COMP: equity-settled share-based compensation (NT$1,246.1 million, cash-flow add-back). The employee-benefits note also lists NT$304.1 million of cash-settled share-based payments, which are paid in cash and excluded; TSMC's much larger employee profit-sharing bonuses are cash and are not counted here. footprint.notes: All figures are from the 2025 Form 20-F on sec.gov (filed Apr 2026). Employees: Item 6.D table of full-time employees by location, Dec 31, 2025 (total 90,557); the seven Taiwan locations (Taipei City is new in 2025, 14 employees) are recorded as regions (countries ["TW"]) because the table has no Taiwan total, and none was summed. North America and Europe are the table's own groupings (no country list). Fabs: the 20-F gives fab counts in words ("nine of our fabs are located in the Hsinchu Science Park, two fabs are located in the Central Taiwan Science Park, seven fabs are located in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, two fabs are located in the United States, one fab is located in Shanghai, one fab is located in Nanjing, and one fab is located in Japan"); quotes carry a bracketed [nine = 9] style annotation. These counts include advanced backend fabs (seven, up from five). The fab sentence's areas may not match the employee table's rows of the same name: the fab table places Fab 22 (Kaohsiung, in production since 2025) in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, while the employee table lists Kaohsiung Nanzih separately, and Taoyuan City and Miaoli County show employees but no fab, so a row's fab count and employee count may not describe exactly the same area. Shanghai and Nanjing (one fab each) are shown as sites, not summed into a China fab count. No U.S. state rows: the U.S. fabs are one in Washington State (Fab 11) and one in Arizona (Fab 21), shown as sites with state codes; no per-state employee or investment figures are published in the 20-F. Fab 24 (Dresden) is not yet operating; Fab 20 (Hsinchu, 2nm, 2025) is in the fab table but not listed as a site. Site descriptions take year/wafer size/technology from the 20-F fab table (as of Feb 28, 2026; technology as of 2025 year-end).
